_note: THE course registry, and the only place a course is described. The CODE is the identity; everything else references it and nothing else. A course legitimately has SEVERAL names and each is its own field with its own job: 'name' the everyday one the timetable and class cards print, 'short' the pill suffix, 'title'/'subtitle' the card headline in Evan's wording, 'officialTitle' exactly what the institute's sheet says. The pill label is COMPUTED as "CODE (short)", never stored. officialTitle and ltpc are read off the 2026-09-08 sheet's own Title / L-T-P-C / Faculty table, which is the half of the document the week grid is NOT transcribed from, so it doubles as the check tools/check_timetable.py runs. This file replaces three earlier sources that disagreed: COURSES in js/timetable.js, linksData.courses and COURSE_META in js/scripts.js. Key order is display order.
